# Each call costs 1.00 and the cap is 1 dollar. The first two agents start, and one finished call is enough: the check then finds the spend at the cap, and no third agent starts. A second run with a STOP file starts none.
isolate
swarmfakes

exec obeeswarm item add swarm swarm-1 --title 'The swarm' --body-file backlog.txt
env CAP_USD=1
exec obeeswarm run swarm-1 swarm --workflow swarm/workflow.star

# Two tasks ran and landed, two did not start.
grep -count=2 '^task ' calls.log
grep -count=2 '^MergePR ' forge/calls.log
exec grep -rhao '2 landed, 0 need a person, 2 not started' state

# The ledger holds both calls.
grep -count=2 'task	1$' home/.swarm/swarm-1/ledger.tsv

# With a high cap and the file STOP, a new swarm starts no agent.
env CAP_USD=100
cp backlog.txt backlog2.txt
exec obeeswarm item add swarm swarm-9 --title 'Again' --body-file backlog2.txt
cp stop home/.swarm/swarm-1/STOP
exec obeeswarm run swarm-9 swarm --workflow swarm/workflow.star
grep -count=2 '^task ' calls.log

-- stop --
-- cost --
1.00
-- backlog.txt --
P0	one	a.txt
P1	two	b.txt
P2	three	c.txt
P3	four	d.txt
